label: Bible Study
prompt: Thou shalt not bear _____ witness against thy neighbour.
verse: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
note: 'Bear false witness' is courtroom language — but the commandment covers the backyard fence too.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will give you _____ according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verse: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
note: God promises 'pastors according to mine heart' — shepherds who feed with knowledge.

label: Sunday School
prompt: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his _____ filled the temple.
verse: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
note: In the year King Uzziah died, Isaiah saw the Lord enthroned, his robe's train filling the whole temple.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be _____: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
verse: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
note: Jesus quotes this on the night before the cross, foretelling the disciples' flight (Matthew 26:31).

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To the Lord our God belong mercies and _____, though we have rebelled against him;
verse: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
note: Daniel's great prayer: we rebelled, yet to God belong 'mercies and forgivenesses' — plural, because one would never be enough.
